positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: how is the Zypherion adoption decision announced, justified, and committed to?
positions.why: Quinton's three spoken segments cohere as a single decisional act: declaring the adoption (src-1, decision conviction, legitimate authority), justifying it with a quantified performance claim (src-2, claim conviction, rational-persuasion/expert power), and committing the org to a migration timeline (src-3, decision conviction, legitimate authority). The directional read spans announcement, evidence, and commitment — one settled choice articulated across three speech acts.
